articles.title: Deadly shooting near Paris is a 'racist terrorist attack', Macron says
articles.summary: One person is killed and five wounded in a series of attacks and the suspected gunman has been apprehended.

articles.title: Seven shot dead by gunmen at church funeral in Jordan, officials say
articles.summary: Thirty-four people are also injured in the attack in southern Karak governorate, and a manhunt is now under way.

articles.title: Freed US citizen was tortured in Russian jail, former Ukrainian prisoners say
articles.summary: Ukrainians held alongside the American say they witnessed beatings and sexual humiliation by Russian guards during his detention.
